name: Mirairo Inc.
summary: Mirairo Inc. dates from 2009 and has its head office in Osaka City, Japan. It offers advisory, research and educational services and digital tools including Mirairo ID, an app that works as a digital disability ID, and Mirairo Connect, which helps overcome communication barriers for people with hearing or speech impairments. It also provides sign language instruction, accessible print materials and signage, and spatial design services.
